label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI, plus Uvation Pulse and Atlas CRM
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 18 items closed on 6 Oct: six product grid, filter and product page front-end subtasks (MT-1234 to MT-1245), the token-claim clean-up (MT-1405, MT-1406), the category-disable plan (MT-1438) and its performance check, the RMA status timeline (MT-1487) and the user account flow (MT-1498). The URL disposition decision was re-raised as MT-1576. A live chat widget story (MT-1577, 3 subtasks) and seven NVIDIA AI server fixes (PC-146 to PC-152, three done) were added. The catalogue re-check (PC-136) is still in progress. Past due fell from 8 to 4.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: A chatbot QA bug (MR-1309) with three subtasks and four more page bugs were raised on 6 Oct; two of those were fixed the same day. Open bugs are now 18, none rated. MR-1168 moved to Ready for Prod. The sitemap fix (MR-1199) and 29 Figma fixes are still Ready for Prod and not released, and related products content on the AI Factory pages (MR-1265) is still blocked. 6 items are past due, five of them June tasks in the 'In Prod1' status.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Quiet on 6 Oct: two bugs closed (one S2 add-on description issue, USP-4056) and one task was added. The three S1 production bugs (wrong AI Factory prices and a Document API 502) are still in To Do, now due 30 Oct. 31 items are past due and 45 bugs are open, 5 of them S1.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: No changes on 6 Oct. Marketplace sign-in for the AI chatbot (UC-225, due 15 Oct) is in progress. The project has 180 open items, but 171 have not been touched in more than 30 days, so most of the 3 Sep agent backlog does not appear in the 30-day figures here. Nothing is past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: No changes since 1 Oct. One item is done (PULSE-329). The other 328 (8 epics, 64 stories, 256 subtasks) are all held by Anshul Bhargava, 246 In Progress and 82 To Do, and none has a due date. Tempo shows 2.5 h in total, on 29 and 30 Sep.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: A second item was added on 6 Oct: a scope and specification subtask for the CRM MVP (ATLAS-2), assigned to Saurabh Jain. ATLAS-1, held by Anshul Bhargava, is still in To Do with no due date and has 8.25 h logged since 28 Sep.
